description: This Python script defines a JSON schema parser, code generator, and related utilities for generating C++ code based on JSON schema definitions, particularly in the context of JSONRPC interfaces. It includes classes for interpreting JSON schema types, managing object references and duplicates, and emitting C++ code for enums, methods, notifications, and registration functions.

classes.name: JsonType
classes.description: Base class for JSON schema types, providing core attributes and methods for handling schema details, naming, descriptions, and C++ type representations.

classes.name: JsonNull
classes.description: Represents a JSON null type, providing its C++ default value and type methods.

classes.name: JsonBoolean
classes.description: Represents a JSON boolean type, with methods to get its C++ class type and standard class name.

classes.name: JsonNumber
classes.description: Represents a numeric JSON type (integer, float, double), with size and signedness attributes for precise C++ type mapping.

classes.name: JsonInteger
classes.description: Inherits from JsonNumber; represents integer types specifically.

classes.name: JsonFloat
classes.description: Represents a JSON float type.

classes.name: JsonDouble
classes.description: Represents a JSON double-precision float type.

classes.name: JsonString
classes.description: Represents a JSON string type with associated C++ string type methods.

classes.name: JsonEnum
classes.description: Handles JSON enum types, supporting enumerator names, values, and duplicate detection.

classes.name: JsonObject
classes.description: Represents a JSON object, managing properties, nested objects, enum collections, duplication, and class naming for C++ code.

classes.name: JsonArray
classes.description: Represents a JSON array, managing element types, duplication, and C++ type representations.

classes.name: JsonMethod
classes.description: Models a JSONRPC method, including method name, parameters, responses, summary, and deprecation info.

classes.name: JsonNotification
classes.description: Models a JSONRPC notification (a special method with 'id' and 'statuslistener' features).

classes.name: JsonProperty
classes.description: Represents a property in a JSON object, with read-only/write-only attributes, index handling, and helper names.

classes.name: JsonRpcSchema
classes.description: Represents a top-level JSON RPC schema, including interface info, included interfaces, list of methods, properties, and events.

classes.name: JsonItem
classes.description: Factory function that creates specific JsonType objects based on schema 'type'.

classes.name: LoadSchema
classes.description: Loads a JSON schema file, preprocesses references, and returns a JSON reference object.

classes.name: ObjectTracker
classes.description: Tracks JSON objects to detect duplicates based on properties and types for code generation optimization.

classes.name: EnumTracker
classes.description: Specialized object tracker for JSON enums, detecting duplicates and managing their references.

classes.name: JsonParseError
classes.description: Exception class for JSON parsing errors.

classes.name: CppParseError
classes.description: Exception class for C++ schema parsing errors.

classes.name: TypePrefix
classes.description: Utility function to generate C++ type prefix for JSON schema types, e.g., 'Core::JSON::'.

classes.name: MakeObject
classes.description: Utility to generate a C++ object type name from base type.

classes.name: MakeArray
classes.description: Utility to generate a C++ array type name from base type.

classes.name: MakeEnum
classes.description: Utility to generate a C++ enum type name from base type.
